markers: YOU MUST BE OF LEGAL DRINKING AGE TO ENTER THIS SITE.
distinguishing_from: vs gdpr_consent: both are full-page interstitials with an accept action, but the age gate asks about the VISITOR'S AGE or birth date and offers a country selector, while a consent wall asks about data processing and carries __tcfapi or a named CMP vendor script.
notes: Cleanest age gate collected: the requirement is stated in plain server-rendered text, not just in class names.

distinguishing_from: vs http_404: HTTP 200 and the title is the real product title (Save 75% on Red Dead Redemption 2 on Steam), so a title-based heuristic sees a normal product page. The gate lives in the URL path and the form ids.
notes: Content-maturity gate rather than a legal-purchase gate. The path segment /agecheck/ is itself the strongest signal.

distinguishing_from: HARD CASE: the full marketing homepage is served (5779 visible-text chars) and the gate is applied client-side. Markup for the gate is present, but the page does not LOOK gated to a text-only reader.
notes: Markers appear once each inside component config, not in rendered copy. Shows why age_gated needs markup and class-name matching, not visible-text matching.
